item.text: I’ve rechecked the current single-file code. At this point, another generic “refactor” would be churn rather than a quality improvement, so I’m not going to make another behavior-equivalent shuffle without a concrete target.

No additional code changes made.

The current code is already a small, clear single-file binary search example. Further generic refactoring would either add unnecessary abstraction or rename things without improving maintainability. Meaningful next targets would be something specific like adding tests, changing the API, handling invalid input, or turning the demo into a reusable CLI.
